        a.latitude                                  as a_lat,
        a.longitude                                 as a_lon,
        b.latitude                                  as b_lat,
        b.longitude                                 as b_lon,
        (b.latitude - a.latitude) * pi() / 180      as lat_dist,
        (b.longitude - a.longitude) * pi() / 180    as lon_dist

    from
        base_airports a

        cross join

    where
        a.country = 'Malaysia'
    and
        b.country = 'Malaysia'

    order by
        1,
        2

),

base_area as (

    select
        *,
        sin(lat_dist / 2) * sin(lat_dist / 2)

with arrivals as (

    select * from {{ ref('base_arrivals__malaysia') }}

),

-- Get the most recent arrival date
most_recent_date as (

    select max(arrival_date) as max_date from arrivals

),

-- Filter arrivals for most recent date, exclude code-share flights
filtered_arrivals as (

    select
        arrival_airport_name,
        arrival_iata,
        arrival_icao,
        count(*) as flight_count

    from
        arrivals

    where
        is_code_share = 'No'
        and arrival_date = (select max_date from most_recent_date)

    group by
        arrival_airport_name,
        arrival_iata,
        arrival_icao

),

airports as (

    select * from {{ ref('base_airports') }}

    where
        country = 'Malaysia'

),

joined as (

    select
        a.airport_id,
        a.name,
        a.latitude,
        a.longitude,
        coalesce(f.flight_count, 0) as flight_count

    from
        airports a

        left join
            filtered_arrivals f
            on a.name = f.arrival_airport_name

)

select * from joined
order by flight_count desc
EOF
